limitations: Live domain content, participants and network timing vary; these individual snapshots do not establish a causal optimization gain.
Model-readiness is first observed at three-second sampling intervals; subinterval differences are not a measured improvement.
Asynchronous load-phase durations can overlap and are not exclusive CPU self-time.
Cross-session asset totals include independent admission and cache lifetimes; per-session totals are separately included.
Native heartbeat bootstrap failure at17:36 remains retained independently; later success does not prove its cause was corrected.
No microphone, public entity mutation, physical-audio or endurance acceptance is claimed.
Experiments remain disabled by default; no Firefox fluidness success may be inferred from Chromium.
